description_en: Modifies the data backup cycle, backup time, backup retention period, and automatic recovery point configurations of a specified Supabase instance
description_zh: 修改指定 Supabase 实例的数据备份周期、备份时间、备份保留天数及自动恢复点配置
name: ModifySupabaseBackupPolicy

parameters.help_en:
The region ID.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/86912.html operation to query available region IDs
parameters.help_zh:
地域ID。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/86912.html接口查看可用的地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: Instance ID of the Supabase instance. You can obtain instance ID on the Supabase page in the console
parameters.help_zh: Supabase实例ID，可以在控制台Supabase页面获取
parameters.name: project_id

parameters.help_en: The start time of the data backup. The time is in UTC and follows the HH:mmZ format, such as 01:00Z. The HH:mmZ-HH:mmZ time range format is also supported, and the server uses the start time of the range
parameters.help_zh: 数据备份开始时间，使用 UTC 时间，格式为 HH:mmZ，例如 01:00Z。兼容 HH:mmZ-HH:mmZ 时间段写法，服务端取其中的开始时间
parameters.name: preferred_backup_time

parameters.help_en: The data backup cycle. Separate multiple values with commas (,). Valid values: Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, Friday, Saturday, and Sunday
parameters.help_zh: 数据备份周期。多个取值用英文逗号（,）分隔。取值：Monday（周一）、Tuesday（周二）、Wednesday（周三）、Thursday（周四）、Friday（周五）、Saturday（周六）、Sunday（周日）
parameters.name: preferred_backup_period

parameters.help_en: The data backup retention period. Unit: days. Valid values: 1 to 7
parameters.help_zh: 数据备份保留天数，单位：天。取值范围：1～7
parameters.name: backup_retention_period

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable automatic recovery points. Valid values:
true: Enabled.
false: Disabled.
If this parameter is not specified, false is used
parameters.help_zh: 是否开启自动恢复点。true：开启；false：关闭。未传入时按 false 处理
parameters.name: enable_recovery_point

parameters.help_en: The interval for the automatic creation of recovery points. Unit: hours. Valid values: 1/6 (10 minutes), 1/2 (30 minutes), 1, 2, 4, and 8. This parameter takes effect only when EnableRecoveryPoint is set to true. If this parameter is not specified, the default value 1 is used. If EnableRecoveryPoint is set to false, this parameter is ignored
parameters.help_zh: 自动创建恢复点的间隔，单位：小时。取值：1/6（10 分钟）、1/2（30 分钟）、1、2、4、8。EnableRecoveryPoint 为 true 时生效，未指定时默认为 1；为 false 时不使用该值
parameters.name: recovery_point_period
